_comment: Example parameter overrides for the dev environment. Copy to dev.json (git-ignored) and fill in real values before deploying — nothing here is a real account/domain. Cross-stack values (VpcId, PrivateSubnetIds, etc.) come from the outputs of previously deployed stacks; fetch them with `aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name <name> --query 'Stacks[0].Outputs'` and paste them in here rather than hardcoding blindly.

messaging.ValidationLambdaRoleArn: <paste ValidationLambdaRoleArn from the security stack's outputs>
messaging.NotificationWiringLambdaRoleArn: <paste NotificationWiringLambdaRoleArn from the security stack's outputs>

compute.PrivateSubnetIds: <paste PrivateSubnetIds from the network stack's outputs>
compute.AppSecurityGroupId: <paste AppSecurityGroupId from the network stack's outputs>
compute.AppInstanceProfileArn: <paste AppInstanceProfileArn from the security stack's outputs>

edge.VpcId: <paste VpcId from the network stack's outputs>
edge.PublicSubnetIds: <paste PublicSubnetIds from the network stack's outputs>
edge.AlbSecurityGroupId: <paste AlbSecurityGroupId from the network stack's outputs>
edge.AppInstanceId: <paste InstanceId from the compute stack's outputs>
